delivery.interpretation: Phase timing and within-construction occupational factors are assumptions; each industry/phase profile is renormalised to preserve total FTE work.

staffing.interpretation: Technical service coverage requirements, not a verified employer roster. Security, cleaning and vendor equipment services remain outside these roles.

programme.interpretation: Budgets, capacities, costs, success/attrition rates and leads are scenario inputs. Training counts and employee stocks do not supply these limits. Construction and operating cohorts are disjoint planning allocations; do not sum them as unique new workers.

guarantee_stress.interpretation: Uncalibrated lifetime exposure illustration; not an estimate of NWF loss, subsidy cost or value for money.

boundaries: Type I: household-induced effects excluded, not estimated as zero.
Construction FTE job-years and operating annual FTE must not be added as contemporaneous jobs.
Operations are procurement-led: on-site FTE plus supplier FTE; data-centre revenue/output/GVA is not imputed.
Gross modeled activity is not net job creation, net welfare, fiscal return or a causal impact.
UK grouped-industry headcount staffing shares proxy Scottish FTE composition; unallocated demand is retained.

guarantee_stress.note: No observed default/loss evidence, tenor, fee/counterfactual or social benefits. This stress illustration is not an official loss estimate or subsidy appraisal.
